RytmRandomizer OXI live set strategy report
OXI live set strategy:
- Rytm acts as second performer for sound design while OXI drives the pattern.
- Analog Four is review-only until an explicit outbound macro path is validated.
Rig roles:
- OXI One (oxi-one) | external sequencer | notes, triggers, mutes, pattern motion
- Analog Rytm MKII (analog-rytm-mkii) | live-safe active target | captured-kit sound-design mutation
- Analog Four MKII (analog-four-mkii) | review-only | tonal companion macro planning
Live chapters:
- 1. capture-anchor | command=kit/resnapshot | macros=kit-core | recovery=captured anchor
  Capture the current Rytm kit before any set movement.
  A4: hold-current-a4-patch
- 2. establish-groove | command=macro hard-groove | macros=kit-core, hard-groove | recovery=home
  Let OXI keep the groove while Rytm tightens source-first pressure.
  A4: review hard-groove A4 macro
- 3. pressure-build | command=macro industrial | macros=hard-groove, industrial | recovery=home
  Raise grit, metal, and energy without releasing the kick anchor.
  A4: review industrial-transition A4 macro
- 4. peak-texture | command=macro industrial | macros=industrial, transition | recovery=home
  Use stronger Rytm sound design as the peak while OXI carries timing.
  A4: review pressure macro only
- 5. space-release | command=macro dub-pressure | macros=dub-pressure | recovery=home
  Pull the kit toward space, delay, reverb, and lower-end pressure.
  A4: review dub-pressure A4 macro
- 6. transition-fill | command=macro transition | macros=transition | recovery=home
  Create a short bridge or fill before the next OXI pattern decision.
  A4: review transition-only
- 7. home-reset | command=home | macros=home | recovery=Z + send
  Return to the captured safe kit before the next chapter.
  A4: no A4 send
Pad policies:
- kick-anchor | pads=1 | primary=SRC micro | filter=protected | lfo=off | amp=foundation only
  Pad 1 stays protected as the kick anchor
- tom-source-motion | pads=6, 7, 8 | primary=SRC | filter=light | lfo=off | amp=overdrive/delay/reverb only
  tom/discovery lanes can move usefully without LFO craziness
- reserved-src-fx | pads=5, 9, 10, 11 | primary=SRC | filter=off | lfo=off | amp=overdrive/delay/reverb only
  common Jose live lane, not a product limitation
- pad-12-optional | pads=12 | primary=SRC/AMP FX | filter=macro-dependent | lfo=off by default | amp=overdrive/delay/reverb only
  available for users who rely on Pad 12
Hardware validation runway:
- rytm-kit-core-smoke | Analog Rytm MKII | operator-present armed Rytm shell | path=kit-core -> changes -> send -> go -> Z + send
  Evidence: full-kit macro sounds musical and returns to no parameter changes staged
  Boundary: requires --arm and explicit shell send/go commands
- rytm-dual-vco-center-band | Analog Rytm MKII | operator-present one-CC or shell smoke test | path=validate current Pad 2/3 Dual VCO CC20 center-band movement
  Evidence: no visible ERR and detune movement remains useful at the chosen amount
  Boundary: stay in proven center band before widening any low-anchor lane
- a4-soft-capture | Analog Four MKII | input-only | path=--arm --a4-soft-capture
  Evidence: tracks 1-4 emit known Appendix D labels for moved controls
  Boundary: opens A4 input only; no output and no MIDI send
- a4-macro-dry-run | Analog Four MKII | passive CLI | path=analog-four-oxi-macro-report hard-groove --events --limit 0
  Evidence: A4 macro rows match the intended OXI companion role before hardware promotion
  Boundary: report-only; no A4 output path
Promotion criteria:
- a4-input-label-coverage | Analog Four MKII | blocked
  Required evidence: known labels for moved controls on tracks 1-4
  Promotes to: A4 macro readiness review
  Safety: input-only evidence comes before any outbound A4 macro path
- a4-macro-review | Analog Four MKII | blocked
  Required evidence: operator-approved passive macro rows for home and one pressure macro
  Promotes to: single-macro outbound rehearsal
  Safety: macro rows stay report-only until the review is explicit
- a4-explicit-arm-gate | Analog Four MKII | blocked
  Required evidence: operator-confirmed --arm path with no unattended behavior
  Promotes to: armed one-shot A4 macro validation
  Safety: no A4 outbound macro send until this gate is satisfied
- a4-recovery-path | Analog Four MKII | blocked
  Required evidence: documented return-to-anchor or neutral macro after a sent A4 change
  Promotes to: candidate live companion macro
  Safety: no live A4 macro without a tested recovery move
Operator cue sheet:
- capture-anchor | OXI=hold or prepare the first pattern | Rytm=kit/resnapshot | Inspect=status
  Fire: no send
  Recover: captured anchor
  A4: hold-current-a4-patch
  Result: current Rytm kit becomes the safe anchor before the set moves
  Blocked: no mutation before anchor capture
- establish-groove | OXI=keep groove, triggers, mutes, and pattern motion running | Rytm=macro hard-groove | Inspect=changes
  Fire: send or go
  Recover: home + send or Z + send
  A4: review hard-groove A4 macro
  Result: tight source-first Rytm pressure over the OXI pattern
  Blocked: no unattended sends
- pressure-build | OXI=increase pattern density or mute tension externally | Rytm=macro industrial | Inspect=changes
  Fire: send or go
  Recover: home + send or Z + send
  A4: review industrial-transition A4 macro
  Result: metallic grit rises while Pad 1 remains protected
  Blocked: no A4 outbound macro
- peak-texture | OXI=hold the peak pattern while sound design carries the lift | Rytm=macro industrial | Inspect=changes
  Fire: send or go
  Recover: home + send or Z + send
  A4: review pressure macro only
  Result: stronger Rytm pressure without releasing recovery
  Blocked: no chaos mode without explicit future opt-in
- space-release | OXI=thin triggers or open mutes for the release | Rytm=macro dub-pressure | Inspect=changes
  Fire: send or go
  Recover: home + send or Z + send
  A4: review dub-pressure A4 macro
  Result: delay/reverb pressure without losing the captured-kit anchor
  Blocked: no unattended sends
- transition-fill | OXI=prepare or launch the next pattern change | Rytm=macro transition | Inspect=changes
  Fire: send or go
  Recover: home + send or Z + send
  A4: review transition-only
  Result: short section movement before the next OXI decision
  Blocked: no transport or pattern writes
- home-reset | OXI=settle the groove or prepare the next chapter | Rytm=home | Inspect=changes
  Fire: send
  Recover: Z + send
  A4: no A4 send
  Result: captured Rytm anchor restored
  Blocked: no persistent kit/project write
Rehearsal checkpoints:
- capture-current-kit | pre-set | command=kit/resnapshot
  Confirm: Rytm sent the intended KIT SysEx
  Success: new kit name and fingerprint are visible
  Blocked: do not mutate before a captured anchor exists
- stage-first-macro | pre-set | command=kit-core or macro hard-groove
  Confirm: macro matches the first planned chapter
  Success: changes shows staged sound-design movement
  Blocked: do not type send before reviewing changes
- inspect-before-send | before-send | command=changes
  Confirm: staged rows match the intended chapter
  Success: operator can name the pads and lanes that will move
  Blocked: no blind sends
- fire-manually | send | command=send or go
  Confirm: Jose is listening with the machines on
  Success: variation sounds useful without visible hardware errors
  Blocked: no unattended hardware behavior
- recover-anchor | recovery | command=home + send or Z + send
  Confirm: recovery command sent after the audition
  Success: no parameter changes staged after recovery
  Blocked: do not continue if recovery is unclear
- promote-a4-only-after-evidence | a4-gate | command=--arm --a4-soft-capture
  Confirm: A4 labels and recovery path are documented
  Success: A4 remains review-only until promotion criteria pass
  Blocked: no A4 outbound macro during Rytm-only rehearsal
- document-after-set | after-set | command=write down useful macros, bad rows, and recovery notes
  Confirm: musical notes and hardware symptoms are captured
  Success: notes captured for the next bundle
  Blocked: do not promote untested behavior from memory alone
Replay / rehearsal commands:
- read-strategy | passive-cli | opens_ports=False | sends_midi=never
  Command: python -m rytm_randomizer.cli oxi-live-set-strategy-report
  Purpose: Read the operator strategy in text form before a rehearsal.
  Expect: report prints OXI roles, chapters, pad policies, and safety notes
  Safety: metadata-only report
- read-strategy-json | passive-cli | opens_ports=False | sends_midi=never
  Command: python -m rytm_randomizer.cli oxi-live-set-strategy-report --json
  Purpose: Expose deterministic JSON for the future GUI/control surface.
  Expect: JSON contains chapters, cues, checkpoints, and replay commands
  Safety: metadata-only report
- review-a4-hard-groove | passive-cli | opens_ports=False | sends_midi=never
  Command: python -m rytm_randomizer.cli analog-four-oxi-macro-report hard-groove --seed 23 --intensity 6 --events --limit 0
  Purpose: Review the A4 companion idea without promoting an outbound path.
  Expect: A4 rows render as dry-run metadata only
  Safety: A4 remains review-only
- start-rytm-live-shell | armed-operator-shell | opens_ports=True | sends_midi=only after explicit in-shell send/go
  Command: python -m rytm_randomizer.app --arm --rytm-live-snapshot-shell --confirm-rytm-snapshot-shell-send
  Purpose: Capture the current Rytm kit and enter the operator-present shell.
  Expect: loaded kit name and fingerprint are visible
  Safety: requires Jose present with hardware on
- stage-hard-groove | in-shell | opens_ports=True | sends_midi=not by itself
  Command: macro hard-groove
  Purpose: Stage the first OXI-style sound-design move.
  Expect: macro is staged but not sent
  Safety: inspect before send
- inspect-staged-plan | in-shell | opens_ports=True | sends_midi=never
  Command: changes
  Purpose: Review pads, lanes, and values before firing.
  Expect: staged rows are printed for operator review
  Safety: must happen before fire-manually
- fire-manually | in-shell | opens_ports=True | sends_midi=operator-confirmed
  Command: send or go
  Purpose: Fire the staged plan only after listening readiness is confirmed.
  Expect: Rytm changes audibly without unattended behavior
  Safety: Jose must be present and listening
- recover-anchor | in-shell | opens_ports=True | sends_midi=operator-confirmed
  Command: home + send or Z + send
  Purpose: Return the hardware to the captured safe kit.
  Expect: changes returns to no parameter changes staged
  Safety: recovery path must stay available
Next hardware validations:
- Rytm full-kit macro smoke test from a fresh current-kit capture
- A4 input-only soft-capture pass before any outbound macro promotion
Safety:
- passive/read-only
- strategy metadata only
- no MIDI sending
- no port opening
- no command execution
- no hardware mutation
- no hardware required
- Analog Four outbound macro send blocked
